The component also supports the common properties [`id`](../common-properties/#id), [`hidden`](../common-properties/#hidden), [`grid`](../grid/), and [`pageBreak`](../page-break/).

| Property                          | Type                                                                                            | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                               |
| --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `type`                            | `"Image"`                                                                                       | Yes      |         | Identifies which component type this configuration represents.                                                                            |
| `textResourceBindings`            | `object`                                                                                        | No       |         | Connects component texts to text resources or expressions.                                                                                |
| `textResourceBindings.altTextImg` | `string \| expression<string>`                                                                  | No       |         | Alternative text for the image (for screen readers).                                                                                      |
| `textResourceBindings.help`       | `string \| expression<string>`                                                                  | No       |         | Help text for the image (shown in help text tooltip/popup)                                                                                |
| `image`                           | `object`                                                                                        | No       |         | Configures the image source, width, and alignment.                                                                                        |
| `image.src`                       | `object`                                                                                        | Yes      |         | Image sources for each supported language.                                                                                                |
| `image.src.nb`                    | `string`                                                                                        | No       |         |                                                                                                                                           |
| `image.src.nn`                    | `string`                                                                                        | No       |         |                                                                                                                                           |
| `image.src.en`                    | `string`                                                                                        | No       |         |                                                                                                                                           |
| `image.width`                     | `string`                                                                                        | Yes      |         |                                                                                                                                           |
| `image.align`                     | `"flex-start" \| "center" \| "flex-end" \| "space-between" \| "space-around" \| "space-evenly"` | Yes      |         | Justification/alignment of the image Allowed values: "flex-start", "center", "flex-end", "space-between", "space-around", "space-evenly". |
